programs.name: PM Youth Business & Agriculture Loan Scheme
programs.description: Business and agriculture financing through participating banks for qualifying young applicants.
programs.availability_note: The official portal describes online applications; confirm current intake and bank conditions. No common closing date was verified.

sources.title: PMYP official scheme portal
sources.note: Reviewed official indexed portal text; direct research fetch timed out. Reconfirm terms and application availability on the portal.

terms.label: Published loan tiers
terms.value: Tier 1: up to PKR 500,000. Tier 2: above PKR 500,000 to 1,500,000. Tier 3: above PKR 1,500,000 to 7,500,000.

terms.label: Published markup
terms.value: Tier 1: 0%. Tier 2: 5%. Tier 3: 7%. Confirm the applicable offer and other costs with the bank.

terms.label: Application route
terms.value: Apply online through the official PMYP portal. Bank assessment and product-specific documentation still apply.

criteria.label: Applicant / qualifying owner age
criteria.requirement: General age range 21–45; the lower bound is 18 for IT/e-commerce businesses. Other applicant conditions still apply.

criteria.label: Pakistani residency
criteria.requirement: The portal specifies resident Pakistani applicants.

criteria.label: Requested amount
criteria.requirement: The published tiers extend up to PKR 7,500,000; the bank determines the actual sanctioned amount.

criteria.label: Bank's documentation and appraisal
criteria.requirement: Confirm identity, business viability, security and tier-specific conditions with the participating bank.

programs.name: Akhuwat enterprise financing
programs.description: Enterprise finance with branch-led social and business appraisal. Product terms depend on the relevant project.
programs.availability_note: Ask the relevant branch about the current enterprise product and available funds. A product-specific amount or closing date was not verified.

sources.title: Akhuwat official loan process
sources.note: Process requirements verified. Product amounts differ across published project pages; no numeric enterprise cap is asserted here.

terms.label: Amount and repayment terms
terms.value: Confirm the enterprise loan amount, term and charges with the branch. This reviewed process source does not establish a current product-specific amount.

terms.label: Supporting documents
terms.value: The process lists applicant identity, utility bills and photos, plus guarantor documents. Additional or project-specific documents may be required.

terms.label: Branch appraisal
terms.value: Discuss the application with the relevant branch. Social/business appraisal and the loan approval committee remain institution checks.

criteria.label: Applicant age
criteria.requirement: The official process lists ages 18–62.

criteria.label: Valid CNIC prepared
criteria.requirement: A valid CNIC is required. Karobaar does not collect or verify the number.

criteria.label: Guarantors prepared
criteria.requirement: The process calls for two guarantors outside the family.

criteria.label: Branch service area
criteria.requirement: The applicant must be in the branch's operational area; confirm the local boundary with that branch.

criteria.label: Social and business appraisal
criteria.requirement: The institution evaluates business capacity and its other applicant conditions. This app cannot establish those facts.

programs.name: BOP e-Business Qarza
programs.description: Working-capital running finance for selected existing BOP SME customers.
programs.availability_note: Application is through a link the bank sends to selected customers. The page does not publish a general application deadline.

terms.label: Published markup
terms.value: One-year KIBOR plus 9.99% per annum; ask the bank for the current KIBOR, charges and offer.

terms.label: Term and payments
terms.value: One-year revolving facility; monthly markup on utilized funds. Published processing fee: PKR 9,500 including FED.

terms.label: Application route
terms.value: Use the digital link shared by BOP with selected existing customers, rather than assuming public enrolment.

criteria.label: Applicant age
criteria.requirement: Published age range: 21–60.

criteria.label: BOP banking relationship
criteria.requirement: At least one year of banking relationship with BOP.

criteria.label: Bank invitation
criteria.requirement: The bank shares the digital application link with selected customers.

criteria.label: Requested amount
criteria.requirement: Published facility range: PKR 100,000–3,500,000.

criteria.label: Bank debt-burden and guarantee checks
criteria.requirement: The page specifies maximum DBR 40% and the borrower's personal guarantee. Customer udhaar owed to you is not your borrowing burden.

programs.name: HBL Small Business Finance
programs.description: Secured small-business facilities for working capital and business expansion.
programs.availability_note: The product page lists branch contact for details. Confirm availability, security and the current offer directly.

sources.title: HBL Small Business Finance product page

terms.label: Published maximum
terms.value: Facilities up to PKR 20,000,000, secured by acceptable residential, commercial or industrial real estate.

terms.label: Pricing
terms.value: KIBOR-linked pricing plus the applicable spread; charges depend on the facility and schedule of bank charges. No fixed rate is asserted here.

terms.label: Term
terms.value: Demand finance can run up to three years. Running finance and trade facilities have different terms.

terms.label: Documents and application
terms.value: Prepare CNIC, business data, one-year certified bank statements and relevant property/legal documents. Ask an HBL branch for the complete checklist.

criteria.label: Sponsor / borrower age
criteria.requirement: Published age range: 25–65.

criteria.label: Pakistani residency
criteria.requirement: Resident Pakistani sponsor / mortgagor / borrower.

criteria.label: Actual business operating age
criteria.requirement: Business in operation for at least three years. A ledger's recorded history cannot prove operating age.

criteria.label: Bank statements prepared
criteria.requirement: A certified bank statement for the last one year is listed.

criteria.label: Requested amount
criteria.requirement: The published maximum is PKR 20,000,000; the bank decides the offer.

criteria.label: Property and legal appraisal
criteria.requirement: The bank must evaluate acceptable property, legal documents and the application; Karobaar cannot verify collateral.

programs.name: Meezan Islamic SME Asaan Finance (I-SAAF)
programs.institution: Meezan Bank / State Bank of Pakistan
programs.description: Shariah-compliant working capital or term finance for SMEs, subject to bank and scheme conditions.
programs.availability_note: The bank's page lists the scheme; confirm present allocation and intake. No verified closing date is published in this snapshot.

sources.title: Meezan SME banking: I-SAAF section
sources.note: Page wording says both no existing borrower and no current relationship. Keep relationship status for bank confirmation; do not interpret it permissively.

terms.label: Published maximum
terms.value: Up to PKR 10,000,000 for working capital or term finance.

terms.label: Published pricing
terms.value: The I-SAAF section quotes 9% per annum. Ask the bank for applicable offer terms and charges.

terms.label: Term and security
terms.value: Tenor follows the approved facility terms. Security follows the bank's internal policy.

terms.label: Application route
terms.value: Contact a designated Meezan SME branch and confirm I-SAAF availability and current requirements.

criteria.label: Meezan relationship declaration
criteria.requirement: Published text excludes existing borrowers and also refers to no current relationship. Confirm any existing relationship directly with Meezan.

criteria.label: I-SAAF at another bank
criteria.requirement: The facility may be availed from one bank only.

criteria.label: Requested amount
criteria.requirement: Published limit: up to PKR 10,000,000.

criteria.label: SME status, security and bank review
criteria.requirement: Meezan/SBP policies, security and the bank's assessment still apply. No minimum-sales qualification rule was verified here.
